items.description: Provider investment account; IDs are not WHAB ledger account IDs.

mask.description: Masked account suffix, empty when absent.

balance.description: Provider current balance; null when absent. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

items.description: Current position, independently of the selected activity window.

ticker.description: Ticker, or null when not supplied.

quantity.description: Current quantity; negative denotes a short position. Finite decimal string, not a binary float.

price.description: Provider institution unit price; null when absent. Finite decimal string, not a binary float.

value.description: Current institution position value. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

costBasis.description: Provider total position cost basis; null when absent. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

currency.description: Position and owning account ISO currency.

priceAsOf.description: Provider price date; null when absent.

unrealizedGain.description: Value minus positive reported cost basis for a nonshort position; null otherwise. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

unrealizedReturnPercent.description: 100 * unrealizedGain / costBasis, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places; null when unavailable. Finite decimal string, not a binary float.

unrealizedUnavailableReason.description: Why unrealized gain and percentage are unavailable.

firstRecordedAddition.description: Earliest uncancelled buy or explicit inbound transfer with positive quantity in this window. Not the original acquisition/tax-lot date; null when absent.

realizedGain.description: Unavailable: complete acquisition/disposal lot history is not supplied.

realizedReturnPercent.description: Unavailable: no realized lot return is inferred.

activity.description: Available provider investment history in the requested inclusive window.

items.description: One provider investment event; amounts retain provider sign, positive for cash outflow and negative for inflow.

securityId.description: Security ID, or null for unassociated cash activity.

date.description: Event date within the inclusive requested window.

subtype.description: Provider investment event subtype, or null.

amount.description: Signed event cash amount: positive outflow, negative inflow. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

fees.description: Provider fees, or null. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

quantity.description: Event quantity; zero when absent. Finite decimal string, not a binary float.

price.description: Event unit price, or null. Finite decimal string, not a binary float.

currency.description: Event and owning account ISO currency.

cancelTransactionId.description: ID cancelled by this event, or null.

asOf.description: Offset ISO timestamp when WHAB read the cached snapshot.

providerUpdatedAt.description: Provider last successful Investments update timestamp, or null.

startDate.description: Inclusive activity start; does not change transaction import cutoff.

endDate.description: Inclusive activity end; does not change holdings valuation date.

totals.description: Separate totals per currency; no FX conversion.

items.description: One currency only. Covered totals include only positions with supported positive cost basis; consult coveredPositions before treating zero as measured.

value.description: Value of all positions. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

coveredValue.description: Value of positions with computable unrealized return. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

costBasis.description: Cost basis of covered positions only. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

unrealizedGain.description: Gain of covered positions only; zero with no covered positions. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

coveredPositions.description: Number of positions included in covered totals.

unrealizedReturnPercent.description: Covered gain / covered cost basis * 100; null without coverage. Finite decimal string, not a binary float.

realizedReturnsAvailable.description: False: realized returns require complete lot history.

output.additionDateMeaning: Earliest recorded buy or inbound transfer within the requested history; not an original tax-lot acquisition date.
output.returnMeaning: Unrealized change versus reported position cost basis; excludes distributions and realized returns. Realized returns require complete lot history.

operations.side_effects: Reads already-active Investments provider endpoints. No ledger import, saved cursor, destination, history cutoff or schedule is changed. Does not enable a product, request consent, reconnect or force a fresh institution fetch. Existing provider product billing applies.

operations.name: transactions.uncategorized
operations.summary: List uncategorized transactions with full-match counts, account names, sampling and optional plain table output.

input.description: whab BUDGET trnx uncategorized [--month YYYY-MM] [--limit N] [--posted] [--exclude-transfers] [--format json|table]. transactions and uncategorised are aliases. Name-addressed personal-workspace read.

budget.description: Unique registered budget name or permanent UUID.

month.description: Optional YYYY-MM; omitting it reads all available history.

limit.description: Positive maximum number of returned rows; omit for all. Does not reduce full-match counts or the initial server history read.

excludeTransfers.description: --exclude-transfers excludes both explicit and inferred transfers.

format.description: JSON retains full fields and integer currency minor units. Table formats each currency separately, escapes terminal controls and shortens long text.

output.description: Default JSON projection, or human-readable table text for --format table. All counts are after filters but before the sampling limit. Pending and transfer counts may overlap. No financial amounts are aggregated.

budgetId.description: Permanent budget ID or default workspace ID.

revision.description: Current ledger revision; a read does not authorize a stale write.

data.description: Matching public transactions, newest date first with ID tie-breaker. No intraday time is inferred. Includes reviewed rows, transfers, pending transactions, inflows, zero amounts and off-budget accounts unless explicitly filtered.

items.description: Public transactions record. Additional compatible projection fields may be present.

amount.description: Integer minor units; positive outflow, negative inflow.

pending.description: Pending rows are excluded from cleared spending.

categoryEdited.description: Whether category annotation was explicitly changed.

accountName.description: Name from the same-budget, same-revision public accounts read; falls back to the account ID if the account is unavailable.

categoryAgent.description: Self-declared agent that explicitly assigned this category, when known. Absent/null for legacy or manual categorization. Independent of the transaction import source; preserved by refresh, review, notes and portable saves.

total.description: Number of all matching non-deleted transactions, before --limit.

returned.description: Number of rows actually returned in data.

pending.description: Number of pending matches before the sample limit.

transferFlagged.description: Number flagged as explicit or inferred transfers; can overlap pending.

postedNonTransfer.description: Number that are neither pending nor explicit/inferred transfers.

bySource.description: Full filtered match counts grouped by source; no monetary total or currency conversion.

items.description: One distinct source and its count.

source.description: Public source value; missing source is labeled unknown.

count.description: Number of matching transactions in this group.

byCurrency.description: Full filtered match counts grouped by currency; no monetary total or currency conversion.

items.description: One distinct currency and its count.

currency.description: Public currency value; missing source is labeled unknown.

count.description: Number of matching transactions in this group.

Uncategorized: 0 matched, 0 shown
Pending: 0 | Transfer-flagged: 0 | Posted non-transfer: 0
No matching transactions.

input.description: Bank-management parameters for an explicitly addressed local budget and enabled provider.
